label: spp 40 holdout span
definition: SPP-40: keeper 11 recipe on held-out years 2019-2022 (first SPP out-of-training coverage)

holdout.tierCaveat: REPORTED, NEVER GATING (rule 30 [R-TOUCHPOINT-FOLD] (c)). SPP's calibration determination is keeper 12's 2023-2025 verdict and nothing else; these four years can neither certify nor decertify it. They are also NOT a certified out-of-sample skill number: [R-HOLDOUT] and its three-tier train/validation/locked-test regime were REMOVED 2026-09-09, so no year in this program is protected from being iterated against and there is no certified out-of-sample number anywhere in it (rule 22 coda). What these years ARE is model-SELECTION evidence this lane did not tune on: the recipe was fixed on 2023-2025 and applied here UNREVISED, with no re-cut parameter.
holdout.envelopeCaveat: SPP-SPECIFIC SCOPE. The in-sample-to-holdout DELTA is measured on a like-for-like recipe -- offer_curve_by_group is byte-identical to keeper 11's and now keeper 12's (SHA-256 090abd79..62f65) and the rule-23-frozen thermal_tranches_SPP.csv / campd-unit-outages-short-SPP.csv are neither regenerated nor touched -- so a degraded row is a property of the YEAR, not of a changed configuration. THE YEAR PROPERTY THAT MOVES IS THE DELIVERED GAS PRICE: 2019 $2.57, 2020 $2.03, 2021 $3.72, 2022 $6.45 against the $2.19-$3.52 window the bands were set in. Four of the five degraded rows (fuelmix, price_mean, price_shape, dispatch_corr) share ONE measured signature -- a coal-for-gas substitution that saturates above ~$3.5/MMBtu: model CC_REGULAR share of (CC+PRB) is 0.387/0.438 in 2019/2020 against 0.363/0.402 actual, then 0.138/0.135 in 2021/2022 against 0.301/0.315 actual, while gas rises 74%. NOT ESTABLISHED: the crossover's location is only BRACKETED between $2.57 (passes) and $3.72 (fails). 2021 additionally contains Winter Storm Uri, which drives its price TAIL but NOT its fuelmix miss, since 2022 shows the same substitution without a Uri. SPP-42 ADDENDUM (2026-09-16) -- WHY THESE NUMBERS DID NOT MOVE UNDER KEEPER 12, stated so the unchanged rows are not mistaken for a re-solve that was never done. Keeper 12 arms mustrun_commitment_feasibility_clip, and SPP-42 DID re-solve all four of these years with it (results/calibration/spp42_span_b, pushed, recoverable at be5123c29d82c74f464ebc0f3bc5061be94975d7). THE ARM IS PROVABLY INERT HERE: its dispatch is BYTE-IDENTICAL to this run's in every class and every year (271.8128 / 262.6208 / 269.7705 / 288.1893 TWh), its D-4 rows are byte-identical (33 FAIL rows, same plants, same binding hours, same zero shares) and its D-2 forced energy is byte-identical (5.0294 / 4.7849 / 5.4248 / 5.4898 TWh). THE REASON IS A DATA-COVERAGE GAP, MEASURED not assumed: SPP's CAMPD unit-outage extracts cover 2023-2025 ONLY (880/905/936 windows there, ZERO rows in 2019-2022, likewise the short and lay-up companions), so availability in these years is the FLAT EFOR baseline -- verified directly, min availcap == p05 availcap for all 21 floored ST_GAS plant-groups in 2019 -- and the clip's predicate (available capacity below the plant's own committed level) can never fire. The engine says so itself: 'mustrun_commitment_feasibility_clip ARMED (SPP 2019): 21 floored plant-groups tested, 0 infeasible plant-hours, 0.0 MWh of commitment floor released'. This run therefore REMAINS the correct record for 2019-2022 under keeper 12, and is stamped to it rather than replaced by a numerically identical twin. THE HELD-OUT C8 BREACH SPP-40 NAMED IS NOT ADDRESSED BY THIS LANE and stays open; its root cause is the same missing 2019-2022 outage extract, which is routed as SPP's next DATA-INTAKE item, not a modelling lane.
holdout.caveats_authored_by: SPP-42 (2026-09-16), re-applying SPP-40's correction after the keeper-12 re-stamp reset it. scripts/stamp_touchpoint_holdout.py's hardcoded defaults are NEISO-specific and [R-HOLDOUT]-era: they assert a CAMPD availability-envelope parity story that is not SPP's, and state that 'the touch-once locked test (2019 / H1-2026) is NOT spent here' when 2019 IS one of this bundle's four years and the touch-once regime no longer exists. Both fields have ZERO consumers -- the Run Explorer panels that rendered them were DELETED by the rule 30 [R-TOUCHPOINT-FOLD] (a) amendment of 2026-09-06 -- so this corrects inert-but-false committed prose, not a render path. The stamper defect is REPORTED, not patched: it is shared infrastructure other ISOs' stamped runs carry, and repairing it is not this lane's object (rule 25 [R-ISO-SCOPE]). A RE-STAMP RESETS THESE FIELDS -- re-apply after any re-registration.
